description: Get one weekly top-5 roster for a market, layer, and pillar. Use this for 'top 5', 'who is in the report', or a Headlines / Beyond pillar. For the paragraph on one rank, call attic_get_report_entry. For a name across pillars, use attic_search. layer=beyond is Attic Beyond and needs an API key.

layer.description: headlines (public weekly top 5) or beyond (Attic Beyond, paid).

market.description: Market: rare-coins, sports-cards, collector-cars, or art. Names such as Rare Coins or fine art are accepted.

pillar.description: Pillar slug or name. Slugs: collectors, the-objects, houses, price-indexes, gatherings, brands-of-influence, wealth-transfer, asset-based-lending, authentication, infrastructure, independent-appraisers, forgery-fakes-scandal, the-numbers, insights-in-depth.

name: attic_get_market_report
title: Get a weekly market report
